notes: The Imam is named only by the title «العبد الصالح» (rule 11: a source known only by a title): read as written, not completed
The twelve previous reports all open with a back reference and none writes a chain, so nothing is inherited; only what the text names is written
«قال: سمعت العبد الصالح يقول» makes the Imam the last link after Abu Hamza (owner ruling 2)
